description: JavaScript implementation of a color picker widget (jscolor), including functions for color manipulation, UI rendering, event handling, and URI parsing, used within the SuiteCRM theme.

classes.name: jscolor
classes.description: Main object encapsulating color picker functionality, including methods for initialization, event handling, color conversion, and UI rendering.

classes.name: jscolor.URI
classes.description: Class for parsing and manipulating URIs, supporting RFC3986 standard.

classes.name: jscolor.color
classes.description: Constructor for color objects managing HSV/RGB values, conversions, and UI interactions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the jscolor library and installs event handlers.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Adds event listeners to DOM elements, compatible with older IE versions.

methods.name: requireImage
methods.description: Registers an image filename to be loaded for the color picker UI.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads an image file and caches it for use in the color picker.

methods.name: getElementPos
methods.description: Calculates the absolute position of an element on the page.

methods.name: getRelMousePos
methods.description: Gets the mouse position relative to an element.

methods.name: getViewPos
methods.description: Returns the current scroll position of the viewport.

methods.name: getViewSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the viewport.

methods.name: detectDir
methods.description: Detects the directory path of the jscolor script.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where jscolor resources are located.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Automatically binds color pickers to input elements with the specified class.

methods.name: showPicker
methods.description: Displays the color picker UI at the calculated position.

methods.name: importColor
methods.description: Imports color value from input element into the color object.

methods.name: exportColor
methods.description: Exports the current color value to input and style elements.

methods.name: fromHSV
methods.description: Sets the color based on HSV values.

methods.name: fromRGB
methods.description: Sets the color based on RGB values.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Parses a hex color string and updates the color object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the color as a hex string.
